events.findings: FAA June notices group the future namespace changes with July9 renaming/administrative updates. NWS June12 explicitly plans KPBI→KDJT July9; its1200UTC time is TAF service timing. These preserve two code-specific days and the four old pending proposal IDs. They establish no unknown outer boundary or whole interval. No FAA LID DJT→IATA inference.
events.nextAction: Review authenticated underlying IATA notification and FAA location-identifier action, clarify lifecycle/supersession, apply the separate source policy only within its exact scope.
